title: Her Umbrella Protected Everyone… Except Her 💔 | Animated Short Film
description:
A girl owned an umbrella that never seemed to protect her. ☔

Every time she opened it, the canopy turned toward someone else: a stranger, a shivering child, a tiny animal caught in the rain. She stayed soaked while the people around her found shelter.

When the storm grew worse, she had one last choice to make. What happens when kindness feels like it costs you everything?

THE UMBRELLA THAT CHOSE OTHERS is an original, dialogue-free 2D animated short about compassion, being seen, and the unexpected ways kindness returns. Told through expressive animation, English micro-captions, original instrumental music and sound effects.

💛 You deserve kindness too.
